lines: Leo the Farmer. A little farm. A very big day.
Good morning, Jojo! The farm is waiting.
What do farmers wear? A raincoat? A swimsuit? Pajamas and slippers?
Hmm. A shirt, overalls, and boots!
Now they are ready. Two friends, two buckets, and a path full of possibilities.
Which ones? Cows? Horses? Pigs? Rabbits? Chickens? Goats? Ducks?
Hay for the big mouths. Grain for the little beaks. Nobody misses breakfast.
Jojo sits very still. Little by little, the empty pail fills up.
Jojo pulls. And pulls. One more tug... Pop! A carrot! Leo lifts a pumpkin with both paws.
Up goes Leo. Down comes an apple. Jojo catches it. And another. And another!
My arms are full! How will we carry all this? A plate? A bag? A trash can?
Try a basket and a box.
Apples in the box. Pears in the basket. Together, they carry the harvest home.
Jojo has found one more job. A very quiet one.
Full baskets. Full bellies. Sleepy friends. A good day's work on the farm.
